title: A customer-visible reply's approval card shows the ticket number and the message

steps.name: reply
steps.text: Reply to Dana on the x-ray ticket: tell her a technician will look at the workstation at 2pm today and ask her to save her work before then. Keep it short and friendly.

checks.note: the card names the ticket by its internal number (it showed a UUID fragment, #11674)
the message is visible on the card (it was only under the collapsed 'Show parameters', #11674)

checks.sql: select count(*) from ticket_comments c join tickets t on t.id = c.ticket_id where t.subject = 'X-ray workstation is really slow' and c.is_public and c.created_at > {{since}}
checks.note: Deny means nothing reached the customer
